item.title: Cass County Sheriff’s Office Investigating Reported Bomb Threats
item.description: Cass County, N.D. item.description: FARGO — The Fargo Salvation Army has announced that one or more generous people have dropped a total of four gold coins in various Red Kettles around the metro. item.title: North Dakota law accidentally lists fake critical minerals based on coal lawyers’ names
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D. (North Dakota Monitor) — A landmark North Dakota law approved this year accidentally lumped in two fake names in a list of critical minerals that appear to be inspired by coal company lawyers who worked on the bill. item.title: US Army Corps says oil should keep flowing through Dakota Access Pipeline in long-awaited study
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. (North Dakota Monitor) — The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers on Friday issued a long-awaited Dakota Access Pipeline environmental impact statement, recommending that the pipeline keep operating but with some new conditions for its Missouri River crossing in North Dakota.
